long_biography.plain_text:
After earning a science degree in the United States, Fouad Alghanim became one of Kuwait University's first Kuwaiti lecturers. He left teaching after two years to enter business, starting a small contracting enterprise in the late 1960s. That venture developed into Alghanim International and the wider Fouad Alghanim & Sons Group.

Construction remained the group's operating backbone. Alghanim expanded from buildings and civil works into power-station engineering, infrastructure, oilfield services and industrial production, while adding businesses in automotive distribution, real estate, aviation, shipping and hospitality. He also helped establish Kuwait's early mobile-telecommunications industry and later co-founded a Jordanian operator. The group now spans multiple regions, with Alghanim continuing as founder and chairman.

uncertainties.detail: The exact public identity is established by the full patronymic, nationality, birth year and eponymous group. ICIJ's Malta-registry data links Fouad M TH Alghanim to Dia Yachting Limited, and YachtAhoy separately names the same founder-chairman with Lady Dia. The bridge is strong but slightly below certainty because the current yacht's beneficial ownership is not disclosed in a contemporary official registry source.

Kuwait has several prominent Alghanim business branches, including Alghanim Industries, Ali Alghanim & Sons and Alghanim Sons Group. Facts, inheritance mechanics, companies and Forbes profiles from those branches are not transferred to Fouad Mohammed Thanyan Alghanim merely because of the surname.

Reliable institutional evidence establishes that Alghanim left teaching, started a small business and founded the core group. It does not define whether wider family wealth, networks or capital materially enabled that launch. Self-made is therefore used without choosing either the independent-start or advantaged-start subtype.

The private group operates across many unrelated sectors and publishes no comparable sector valuations or earnings. Construction & Engineering is selected because current official sources still identify Alghanim International as the flagship and emphasize infrastructure, power and engineering, but confidence is reduced for the undisclosed portfolio weighting.

Companies House and the professional profile support December 1944, with the latter specifying 20 December. Existing birth country is Kuwait, but no strong reviewed source supplies a city of birth. No secondary nationality is established.

MEED and the professional profile establish founder and extended leadership roles in MTC and Umnia. Mobile telecommunications is assigned as historically defining; no claim is made that these former interests outweigh construction in the principal fortune or current portfolio.

The canonical group website and exact dedicated Wikipedia article are proposed. Focused searches did not establish a dedicated personal LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, X, TikTok, YouTube or personal website above the threshold. No dedicated Forbes profile was found.

The biographies omit vessel details, transient financial figures, private-family information, politics, allegations and offshore-company controversy. The ICIJ record is used only as a historical identity and yacht-entity anchor, with no inference of wrongdoing. No live or compiled change is authorised.

Self-made preserves the documented small-business creation without inventing a family starting position, and Founder captures the direct relationship.
